items.text_en: Walk the terrain with a dowser and a soil surveyor before any intervention.
items.text_hr: Prijeći teren s rašljarom i mjeriteljem tla prije bilo kakvog zahvata.

items.text_en: Harvest the dew that the lichen and moss on the lower ground already prove is there.
items.text_hr: Skupljati rosu za koju lišajevi i mahovina na nižem terenu već dokazuju da je ima.

items.text_en: Avoid any source close to the shore that draws salt when it is pumped.
items.text_hr: Izbjeći svaki izvor blizu obale koji vuče sol kad se crpi.

items.text_en: Passive desalinator built as an earthen vessel, producing both fresh water and salt.
items.text_hr: Pasivni desalinator kao zemljana posuda, daje i slatku vodu i sol.
